prior_importants.description: Needs you reasons are now clipped to 100 characters, on the grounds that 'the whole question is on the session's view'. The conductor's own question (sessionId 'conductor') has no session view, and unminted sessions get no view link. Their question text (up to 300 characters after sanitizeReason) is now cut to about 86 characters with nowhere on the dashboard to read the rest. The conductor's question still renders its answer forms right there.

Every Needs you reason is now cut at 100 characters. For awaiting-review, fix-committed and pr-open lines, needOf adds widenedClause(session.rescoped) to the reason; clipWords drops the decision-188 'scope widened after launch' globs and the (+N more) count, which no other web dashboard view shows.

findings.description: The commit says an unminted session's question prints whole, but no test covers that path: if the condition at web-dashboard-overview.service.ts:421 were narrowed from `open !== ''` to `need.sessionId !== CONDUCTOR_TARGET`, the conductor test and the minted-session clip test would still pass while an unminted session's long question got cut on a line with no link to its full text. A test seeding a non-minted session id with a question over 100 characters, asserting the whole text in the reason span, would catch it.

process_issues.description: Consolidator not spawned: the reviewers returned a single finding in total, so there was nothing to group; dedup was trivially inline. Security, guards and simplicity were skipped: the 49-line delta changes one clip condition inside an already-escaped expression, adds no helper or file, and touches no trust boundary.
